question: The Air (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act was introduced in India in:
solution:
The correct answer is __**1981**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Air (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act was introduced in India in the year **1981**.
 
• This Act was enacted to provide for the prevention, control, and abatement of air pollution.
 
• It establishes the Central and State Pollution Control Boards to monitor and control air pollution.
 
• The Act aims to maintain the quality of air
